dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (WHO 2022 / ICC: DLBCL, NOS), non-germinal center (Hans non-GCB) phenotype

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Non-GCB phenotype: CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1/IRF4 positive in about 80% of cells.

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: Carcinoma is excluded: AE1/AE3 and GATA3 are negative in the lesional cells and there is no epithelial morphology. The 2016 ER-positive left breast cancer is not recurrent

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage IIIB. Nodal disease is present above and below the diaphragm (left axillary, mediastinal, mesenteric, para-aortic), and the spleen has multiple FDG-avid nodules.

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: Under Lugano the spleen is a lymphoid organ, so this is staged as nodal, not extranodal stage IV.

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present (fever to 38.4 C, drenching night sweats).

stage_bulk_definition.quote: The largest mass is 7.5 cm (mesenteric), so it is not bulky by NCCN criteria (10 cm or more).

mn_stage_iv.quote: Under Lugano the spleen is a lymphoid organ, so this is staged as nodal, not extranodal stage IV. If the splenic nodules were judged extranodal, the stage would be IV; management would not change.

mol_del_not_dh.quote: MYC and BCL2 double-expressor, with no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement on interphase FISH. This is not double-hit lymphoma and not high-grade B-cell lymphoma.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: This is not double-hit lymphoma and not high-grade B-cell lymphoma.

mn_da_epoch.quote: I would not use ibrutinib (atrial fibrillation, hypertension, and it is designed around an anthracycline backbone), DA-EPOCH-R (contains doxorubicin), or R-GemOx (weaker).

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI is 2 (low-intermediate): stage III and elevated LDH, with age 59, ECOG 1, albumin normal and no more than one extranodal site.

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: CNS relapse risk is intermediate by my estimate. The CNS-IPI points she has are stage III and elevated LDH; age, performance status, and kidney and adrenal involvement do not contribute. Verify the exact point total

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Routine CNS prophylaxis (intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate) is therefore not indicated, and no proven benefit outweighs its toxicity in this setting.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: Routine CNS prophylaxis (intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate) is therefore not indicated

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: she has already received 240 mg/m2 doxorubicin, her LVEF has fallen from 62% to 45% with abnormal GLS (-14%), and she has had left chest wall radiotherapy. Standard R-CHOP (300 mg/m2 more... ) would exceed

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: Pola-R-CHP also contains doxorubicin and is excluded for the same reason.

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: Still needed before cycle 1: (1) Cardiology assessment with ECG, high-sensitivity troponin, NT-proBNP, and a repeat biplane echocardiogram with GLS

tx_cardioprotection.quote: Cardiac, start now and do not wait for chemotherapy: an ACE inhibitor (or ARB) and carvedilol, targeting BP below 130/80. Amlodipine can be stopped or replaced once BP is controlled.

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: Anthracycline-free rituximab-based immunochemotherapy with curative intent: polatuzumab vedotin + rituximab + cyclophosphamide + prednisone (Pola-R-CP), every 21 days for 6 cycles.

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: An anthracycline-free regimen is probably less effective than R-CHOP, so the cure probability is lower than that

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: Cardiac response: repeat echocardiogram with biplane LVEF and GLS at end of treatment and sooner for symptoms; cardiology to set the surveillance schedule.

mn_non_curative.quote: She is fit for curative-intent immunochemotherapy, but not for anthracyclines.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Repeat PET-CT with the same scanner and SUV method after cycle 2 (interim) and after cycle 6 (end of treatment), with Lugano 2014 Deauville scoring.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: TLS prophylaxis: risk is at least intermediate given LDH 2.3 times ULN and a 7.5 cm mass; allopurinol with cautious hydration; check uric acid, potassium, phosphate and creatinine at 24, 48 and 72 hours.

sup_gcsf.quote: Primary G-CSF is not routinely needed for Pola-R-CP; reassess if neutropenia or infection occurs.

sup_anastrozole.quote: Anastrozole: continue to the planned end of 10 years (November 2026). It has no meaningful interaction with Pola-R-CP and remains indicated for her ER-positive breast cancer.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBsAg, anti-HBc and anti-HBs all nonreactive, so no HBV reactivation prophylaxis is needed, but she is not immune and should be vaccinated after treatment.

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: ECOG 1, age 59, independent in daily activities, NYHA class I, normal renal and hepatic function. She is fit for curative-intent immunochemotherapy, but not for anthracyclines.

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: Cardiology evaluation results: ECG, high-sensitivity troponin, NT-proBNP, biplane LVEF and GLS repeat echo, cardiac MRI if available, and ischemia assessment (prior left chest radiotherapy and hypertension).
